## Local law

| Id | Rule |
|---|---|
| LOCAL-1 | In `backend/`, the model SDK is `google-genai` (`from google import genai`): never import `vertexai` or `google-cloud-aiplatform` there (the `vertexai=True` argument in `backend/app/integrations/vertex_ai_client.py` is the SDK's own switch, not the old package). `law_corpus/` is a separate project and uses `google-cloud-aiplatform` (see Legacy zones). |
| LOCAL-2 | Every model client comes from `create_genai_client()` in `backend/app/integrations/vertex_ai_client.py`, the one place that reads the caller's own key (BYOK, bound per request by `backend/app/middleware/byok_middleware.py`). Never build `genai.Client` anywhere else; never store or log the key (`backend/app/utils/logger.py` redacts it). |
| LOCAL-3 | Query embeddings use `gemini-embedding-001` at 768 dimensions with `task_type="RETRIEVAL_QUERY"`; the corpus was embedded with `RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT`. Changing the model, the dimension or the task type breaks retrieval against the existing collections (`backend/app/integrations/vertex_embedding_client.py`, settings `embedding_model`, `embedding_dimensions`). |
| LOCAL-4 | The backend suite runs only against the disposable database and Redis named in "Checks". Its defaults are `localhost:5432` and `localhost:6379`, which on this machine belong to other services, and `backend/tests/test_rate_limit_middleware.py` calls `flushdb()` on whatever Redis it reaches. |
| LOCAL-5 | `law_corpus/data/` (907 MB, git-ignored) is pipeline output: never hand-edited or committed. Tests that need it are named one by one in `CORPUS_DEPENDENT_TESTS` in `backend/tests/conftest.py`; a name that no longer matches a test fails the run, so rename it there in the same commit. |
| LOCAL-6 | The kit guard reads the repo's allow-list: `frontend/.fuzzzy_guard_allow` holds one exact `path:line` pin per line, each with its reason. Never pin a whole file; a new literal is fixed, not pinned. |
| LOCAL-7 | A barrel never exports a file whose first lines carry `// exporter:ignore` on a line of their own (the two halves of a conditional import, e.g. `dependency_injection_native.dart` and `_web.dart`). Never hand-trim a generated barrel. |

## Legacy zones

<!-- New modules follow the handbook shape. An edit inside a legacy file keeps that file's structure and
     adds no new violation. A legacy pattern is never copied into new code. -->

| Folder or file | Non-conforming | Rule for editing there |
|---|---|---|
| `frontend/lib/src/features/` | Every feature uses `view/{pages,components}` instead of `ui/{pages,widgets}`; cubits and repositories are flat files, not folders with a `part` state file or `<name>_repository_responses/`; no `mocked_` data sources (FZ-FLT-LAYER-01, FZ-FLT-DATA-01) | keep the feature's own layout when editing it; a new feature gets the handbook shape (`ui/`, cubit and repository folders), copied from `fuzzy_starter/lib/src/sample_posts/`, never from here |
| `frontend/lib/src/features/consultation/` | `view/pages/consultation_page.dart` is 1,864 lines, `questionnaire_page.dart` 675, `bloc/consultation_cubit.dart` 772 (limits 150 and 200); widget-returning methods in pages; `data/data_sources/` and `data/turns/` use `try` | add no lines to the oversized files beyond the task; new UI goes into its own widget file |
| `frontend/lib/src/features/cases/` | `case_workspace_page.dart` 487 lines, `case_detail_cubit.dart` 494; most hardcoded Georgian strings (18 files); 783 `//` comment lines; literal styles in 11 view files | as above; no new literal, string or comment |
| `frontend/lib/src/features/profile/` | `bloc/model_config_cubit.dart` uses `try/catch` and calls `sl.get` (FZ-FLT-L2, FZ-FLT-DI-01); `data/model_config_repository.dart` is not a folder and reads `sl` itself | do not copy; touch the `try` only when the task is this cubit |
| `frontend/lib/src/features/auth/` | no `bloc/`; `view/` pages read `sl.get` directly; the data source catches with `try` | do not copy |
| `frontend/lib/src/features/laws/`, `frontend/lib/src/features/feedback/` | pages over 150 lines, widget-returning methods, hardcoded Georgian strings | keep structure; no new violation |
| `frontend/lib/src/app/navigation/`, `frontend/lib/src/features/.../view/pages/` | repositories and data sources are built inline in `BlocProvider(create: …)`, not registered in `sl` | build a new feature's repository the same way until the feature moves to the handbook shape; never call `sl` inside a repository or cubit |
| `frontend/lib/src/app/theme/` | `legal_domain_colors.dart` holds 16 literal colours, pinned in `frontend/.fuzzzy_guard_allow` | no new literal; colours come from `context.fuzzzyColors` |
| `frontend/lib/src/app/globals/bloc/theme_cubit/`, `frontend/lib/src/core/services/logger/` | `try/catch` in `theme_cubit` and `log_reader_cubit`; non-barrel `package:` imports in the logger | leave; fix only as its own task |
| `frontend/lib/src/core/` | non-barrel `package:fuzzzy_law/src/...` imports in 5 files (FZ-FLT-L4); `services/dev_panel/ui/` is the only `ui/` folder and holds `screens/` | import only `package:fuzzzy_law/src/src.dart` in anything you add |
| `frontend/lib/src/core/l10n/` | only one file reads `context.fuzzzyLawLocalizations`; user text is hardcoded Georgian in about 40 view files; `app_ka.arb` lacks 40 of the 173 English keys | every new string is a key in both `.arb` files; a string you touch moves to a key |
| `frontend/lib/` and `frontend/test/` | `fvm dart format --set-exit-if-changed` would change 56 files at base | format only the files you change; never reformat a whole folder in a feature commit |
| `frontend/test/` | flat `test/<name>_test.dart`, not mirrored per feature and layer; no `mocktail` or `bloc_test` | new tests go to `test/<feature>/<layer>/`; existing tests stay put |
| `backend/app/` | layered by type (`routes/`, `services/`, `repositories/`, `models/`, `schemas/`, `middleware/`, `integrations/`), not one folder per feature (FZ-PY-SHAPE-01); services hold `except Exception` (35) and `Any` (125); routes raise `HTTPException` and build services inline (`ConversationService(db)`); module-level `settings` and `prompts` singletons; the app factory, settings, logging, database session, rate limiting and auth are its own, not consumed from `fuzzzy_core_backend` (FZ-PY-CORE-01) | keep the layer layout and the route → service → repository → model direction; add no `except Exception`, no `Any`, no new module-level singleton |
| `backend/app/services/agent_pipeline_service.py`, `backend/app/routes/ws_chat_router.py` | 1,383 and 670 lines | add only what the task needs |
| `backend/app/` and `backend/tests/` | `ruff check` (the project config) reports 458 findings at base: 235 line-too-long, 82 unsorted imports, 73 unused imports, 47 whitespace | your own lines pass the full config; the must-pass lint is the errors-only subset in "Checks" |
| `backend/tests/test_ws_user_message_persists.py` | waits on the wall clock (`asyncio.sleep`, `time.sleep`; FZ-TEST-CLOCK-01): in the full suite on a loaded machine `test_answer_is_stored_even_if_the_client_drops_during_the_guardrail` failed 2 of 8 runs on 2026-10-01 (alone it passes) | the flaky test is deselected from the must-pass "backend test" and listed under Checks pending; fixing it (an injected clock or an awaited event instead of sleeps) is its own task, which then removes the `--deselect`; add no new sleep-based test |
| `backend/tests/` | flat `test_<name>.py`, not mirrored per feature (FZ-PY-TEST-01) | new tests go next to the existing ones, one file per service or route |
| `backend/pyproject.toml` | dependency ranges (`>=`), not exact pins; `pip install -e .` fails (flat layout finds `app` and `alembic`) | install as in "Checks" setup; pin a new dependency exactly |
| `law_corpus/` | a separate Python project (`law-corpus-pipeline`, its own `law_corpus/pyproject.toml` with `>=` ranges and its own `law_corpus/tests/`); `pipeline/indexer/vector_store_indexer.py` imports `google-cloud-aiplatform` for Vector Search; no check in this file or in CI runs it | run it only on request; never import it from `backend/` (the backend reads only its outputs under `law_corpus/data/`); no new `aiplatform` use outside the indexer |
| `.archive/...`, `.stash/...`, `.tasks/...`, `.user_tasks/...`, `master_plan/...`, `improvement_ideas/...`, `curr.md`, `pipeline_visualization.md`, `frontend/.plans/`, `frontend/documents/` | planning notes and old docs inside the code tree | do not add to them; new plans go to HQ |
| `generate_500_lexicon.py`, `generate_500_lexicon2.py`, `generate_dart.py`, `generate_terms.py`, `patch_cors.py`, `test_options.py`, `backend/scratch.py` | one-off scripts at the repository root and in `backend/` | never run them from a build unit; never import them |
| `tests/e2e/...` | Playwright suite against a served web build; not run by any check | run only on request, against a local build |
| `.agents/workfiles/_legacy/` | the old agent folders (role contexts, workflows, prompts, the frontend orchestrator, personas and bootstrap) | history only; never read as law |

## Repo facts

### Checks

<!-- Run from the repository root, on the committed tree, with `set -o pipefail`. Verified green on
     2026-10-01 at 62fc2d6 in a fresh worktree: setup first, then every command in this order,
     ending with `git status --porcelain` empty. -->

Setup, once per fresh worktree, in this order (none is a check):
1. Flutter pin. No tracked `.fvmrc`; the main checkout carries a git-ignored `frontend/.fvm/fvm_config.json`. A fresh worktree: `cd frontend && fvm use 3.32.0 --force --skip-pub-get && rm .fvmrc` (keeps the ignored `.fvm/`, removes the untracked pin file).
2. Kit. `frontend/pubspec.yaml` takes `fuzzzy_ui_kit` by path `../../fuzzy_design`: a `fuzzy_design` checkout must sit beside the repository checkout. The main checkout has it; a worktree under `~/worktrees/fuzzzy_law/` needs `~/worktrees/fuzzzy_law/fuzzy_design` (verified with a detached `fuzzy_design` worktree at `origin/master` 589c735, linked there).
3. `cd frontend && fvm flutter pub get`
4. `python3.11 -m venv backend/.venv`, then install `backend/pyproject.toml`'s `dependencies` and `dev` extra by name (`pip install -e` fails): `backend/.venv/bin/python -c "import tomllib; p = tomllib.load(open('backend/pyproject.toml', 'rb'))['project']; print('\n'.join(p['dependencies'] + p['optional-dependencies']['dev']))" | backend/.venv/bin/python -m pip install -r /dev/stdin`
5. `backend/scripts/test-db.sh up` (disposable Postgres on `127.0.0.1:55432`, migrated with `alembic upgrade head`) and a disposable Redis: `docker run -d --name fuzzzy_law_test_redis -p 127.0.0.1:56379:6379 redis:7-alpine`.

### Frontend dependency registration
- Applies to: `frontend/lib/src/core/dependency_injection*.dart`, `frontend/lib/src/app/navigation/**`, `frontend/lib/src/features/*/data/**`, `frontend/lib/src/features/*/bloc/**`
- `sl` (GetIt) holds app-wide services only: `frontend/lib/src/core/dependency_injection.dart` registers them with `sl.safeRegisterSingleton<T>(…)` (`SecureStorageService`, `DeviceIdService`, `ModelPreferenceService`, `ChatTurnRegistry`, `FuzzzyLawHttpClient`, `FuzzzyLawPublicHttpClient`, `PackageInfo`); `dependency_injection_native.dart` / `_web.dart` are the conditional halves.
- Features are not registered: the route builds the cubit, its repository and data source in `BlocProvider(create: (_) => XCubit(repository: XRepository(remoteDataSource: XRemoteDataSource())))` (`frontend/lib/src/app/navigation/fuzzzy_law_router.dart`). Remote data sources take the HTTP client with `sl.get<FuzzzyLawHttpClient>()`.

### Frontend localisation
- Applies to: `frontend/lib/src/core/l10n/**`, `frontend/lib/src/features/*/view/**`, `frontend/lib/src/app/**`
- Sources: `frontend/lib/src/core/l10n/app_en.arb` (template), `app_ka.arb`; config `frontend/l10n.yaml`; class `FuzzzyLawLocalizations`, read as `context.fuzzzyLawLocalizations.<key>`. The app's user text is Georgian.
- Regenerate: `fvm flutter gen-l10n` (in `frontend/`)
- Regenerated by tool, never hand-edited: `frontend/lib/src/core/l10n/generated_localizations/fuzzzy_law_localizations.dart`, `fuzzzy_law_localizations_en.dart`, `fuzzzy_law_localizations_ka.dart`
- `./loc.sh "English||ka||ქართული"` (in `frontend/`) adds a key to both files (read, not run).

### Frontend tests and harness
- Applies to: `frontend/test/**`
- Layout today: flat `frontend/test/<name>_test.dart`, 15 files. Dev dependencies are `flutter_test` only: hand-written fakes, no `mocktail` or `bloc_test`.
- `frontend/test/fuzzzy_guard_test.dart` runs the kit guard as a test; it fails when a pin in `.fuzzzy_guard_allow` no longer matches a violation.

### Frontend HTTP errors
- Applies to: `frontend/lib/src/features/*/data/**`, `frontend/lib/src/core/customized_http_clients/**`
- `FuzzzyLawHttpClient` (Dio) throws typed exceptions from `frontend/lib/src/core/services/http_client/http_client_interface/http_client_exceptions/`; the mapping is `FuzzzyLawRestApiExceptionTranslator`. Error bodies are read as `message` and `errorCode` only when they are a JSON object.

| Outcome | Exception thrown |
|---|---|
| status 400 · 401 · 403 · 404 · 409 · 429 | `BadRequestException` · `UnauthorizedException` · `ForbiddenException` · `NotFoundException` · `ConflictException` · `TooManyRequestsException` (all `extends ClientErrorException`) |
| other 4xx | `ClientErrorException` |
| status 500 · 501 · 502 · 503 | `InternalServerErrorException` · `NotImplementedException` · `BadGatewayException` · `ServiceUnavailableException` (all `extends ServerErrorException`) |
| other ≥ 500 | `ServerErrorException` |
| no status code | `UnsuccessfulResponseException` |
| no response: connect · receive · send timeout · connection error | `ConnectionTimeoutException` · `RecieveTimeoutException` (sic) · `SendTimeoutException` · `NoConnectionException` |
| no response: anything else | `NetworkException` |
| parse failure | `JsonDeserializationException` (`extends DeserializationException`) |

### Frontend kit widgets
- Applies to: `frontend/lib/src/features/*/view/**`, `frontend/lib/src/app/**`, `frontend/test/**`
- Kit: `fuzzzy_ui_kit` 0.1.0 by path `../../fuzzy_design` (not a git tag); import only `package:fuzzzy_ui_kit/fuzzzy_ui_kit.dart`. The kit is read-only here.
- Roles from the context: `context.fuzzzyColors`, `fuzzzyTextStyles`, `fuzzzySpace`, `fuzzzyRadius`, `fuzzzyDensity`, `fuzzzyMotion`, `fuzzzyFormStyles`. `frontend/lib/src/app/theme/fuzzzy_law_theme.dart` is the one bridge from roles to `ThemeData`, including the Georgian `fontFamilyFallback`.
- An app-side widget built on roles when no kit widget fits: `frontend/lib/src/features/cases/view/components/app_status_chip.dart`.

### Backend dependency wiring
- Applies to: `backend/app/**`
- App factory: `backend/app/main.py` `create_app()` adds the middleware (rate limit, credit gate, Firebase auth, BYOK, error handler, CORS) and includes one router per `backend/app/routes/*_router.py`.
- The database session comes from `Depends(get_db)` (`backend/app/models/database.py`); routes build services inline (`ConversationService(db)`); settings are the module-level `settings` in `backend/app/config/settings.py`.

### Backend errors
- Applies to: `backend/app/**`, `backend/tests/**`
- No error catalog or generated envelope. `backend/app/middleware/error_handler_middleware.py` catches what a route lets escape: a provider fault classified by `backend/app/utils/provider_errors.py` `classify()` renders its status with `{"error": <code>, …}`; anything else renders 500 `{"error": "internal_server_error", …}`. Routes raise `HTTPException` for their own 4xx.

### Backend tests and harness
- Applies to: `backend/tests/**`
- Layout: flat `backend/tests/test_<name>.py`; fixtures in `backend/tests/conftest.py`; recorded data in `backend/tests/fixtures/`. pytest runs with `asyncio_mode = "auto"` and ignores `tests/scripts` and `tests/test_scratch.py` (`backend/pyproject.toml`).
- The database tests need the migrated disposable Postgres; the rate-limit tests need Redis (see Checks).

### Backend settings and running
- Applies to: `backend/app/config/**`, `backend/app/main.py`
- Settings: `backend/app/config/settings.py` (pydantic-settings, reads the environment and a local `.env` that is never committed or read by an agent). Python 3.11.
- Local run is Docker Compose (`backend/dev_runner.sh`, read, not run). Deploy scripts are owner-gated (README "Never").

### Generators
- Applies to: `frontend/**`, `backend/alembic/**`

| Command | Rewrites |
|---|---|
| `./exp.sh` (in `frontend/`) | the barrel `<dir>/<dir>.dart` in every folder under `frontend/lib/src`, `lib/src/src.dart` included; idempotent; the first run creates the git-ignored `frontend/scripts/.venv` |
| `fvm flutter gen-l10n` (in `frontend/`) | `frontend/lib/src/core/l10n/generated_localizations/` |
| `./gen.sh <brick>` (in `frontend/`; read, not run) | `mason make` with the bricks in `frontend/code_generators/bricks/` (`remote_feature_template_brick`, `paginated_remote_feature_template_brick`, `form_page_brick`, `filter_bloc_brick`, `remote_template_brick`); the bricks emit the legacy `view/` shape |
| `alembic revision` (in `backend/`) | a new migration under `backend/alembic/versions/`; never edit an applied one |

### CI
- Applies to: `.github/**`, `frontend/.gitlab-ci.yml`
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (GitHub Actions) runs the backend lint subset, migrations and pytest against a Postgres service, and the frontend pub get, analyze (`--no-fatal-infos`), test and web build. The frontend job needs the `DESIGN_REPO_TOKEN` secret to check out the kit; the law-drift job needs `HANDBOOK_REPO_TOKEN`. Neither secret is known to exist, and the workflow is not known to have run green. Seen at base without running it on GitHub: its backend install (`pip install -e ".[dev]"`) fails on the flat layout, and it has no Redis service, so the 4 rate-limit tests would fail. It triggers on `main`, `feat/**`, `agent/**`, `stabilize/**`, not on the integration branch.
- `frontend/.gitlab-ci.yml` only generates a changelog on tags.
